name: simulate_flows
description: Estimate the credit cost of `flows_run` before running it, for the same inputs. Call `flows_get` first for input specs. `inputs` is `{inputId: value}`, as for `flows_run`, but may be partial or omitted — missing values are priced with the flow's defaults. Read-only — never charges.

inputs.description: {inputId: value} from `flows_get` — the same inputs you would pass to `flows_run`. Optional: absent inputs are priced with the flow's own defaults.
